searches.reason: Explore replacing fixed recent-item pooling with adaptive task segments and several interest states. This challenges the assumption that the latest few interactions express one coherent purpose. Seek lightweight causal models using interaction IDs and timestamps, with last-item and single-state controls; the supplied deletion probes do not isolate recency from position effects.

searches.reason: Investigate whether candidate-conditioned history matching can distinguish specific relevance from broad associations. Seek practical late-interaction or cross-attention architectures combining collaborative embeddings with title/description TF-IDF or text encoders trained from scratch. Metadata may support finer matching, but cannot establish ownership, compatibility, or satisfied demand without evidence.

searches.reason: Challenge the training objective rather than adding another residual branch. Seek efficient ranking objectives and adaptive negative sampling that distinguish difficult alternatives while accounting for possible false negatives. Industrial_and_Scientific's 24% training wrong-rank rate motivates investigation, but only the unchanged four-dataset macro validation HR@10 can establish improvement. Compare objective-only variants before combining architectures, within the shared GPU budget.
